literature.headline_zh: 诺如病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期诺如病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 在流行病学第50周期间,GII.17[P17]基因型的相对丰度增加,时间上与记录的当地诺如病毒暴发事件相吻合。变异分析显示,污水样本表现出混合的核苷酸模式,多个等位基因以不同的相对频率共存,而非固定的替代。 [10.1128/aem.00760-26]
病毒的高多样性使治疗药物开发变得复杂,其包含超过10个基因组群(GI–GX)和约50个基因型,其中一些基因组群(如GII.4)会持续产生新的抗原变异体。 [Evolution, diversity and distribution of human Noroviruses:From single hosts to global patterns]
六名暴露个体中有四人在食用同一餐后的24-48小时内出现急性胃肠炎(总体发病率为66.7%;特定食物发病率为100%)。三名之前健康的成年人经历了持续15-21天的症状,并在随访期间发展为感染后肠易激综合症(PI-IBS)。相反,一名43岁接受顺铂化疗的宫颈癌患者出现了严重脱水,需要紧急住院治疗。 [10.3390/vaccines14090804]
在30个样本中有5个(16.7%)观察到针对HEV的RT-qPCR信号;然而,所有阳性信号对应的水平均低于估计的定量限(LOQ)。 [10.3390/v18091000]
囊泡高度在不同来源中保持一致,但横向尺寸存在显著差异。诺如病毒、轮状病毒和柯萨奇病毒B3的囊泡粘弹性特性在不同来源中表现出相似性,但在从粪便和原始污水中分离出的囊泡中则存在明显差异。 [10.1021/acs.est.6c06789]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。

Therapeutic development is complicated by the virus's high diversity, with more than 10 genogroups (GI–GX) and approximately 50 genotypes, some of which, such as GII.4, continuously generate new antigenic variants. [Evolution, diversity and distribution of human Noroviruses:From single hosts to global patterns]
Four of six exposed individuals developed acute gastroenteritis (overall attack rate: 66.7%; food-specific attack rate: 100%) within 24–48 h after consuming the same meal. [10.3390/vaccines14090804]
HEV-target RT-qPCR signals were observed in 5 of 30 samples (16.7%); however, all positive signals corresponded to levels below the estimated limit of quantification (LOQ). [10.3390/v18091000]

Vesicle height was consistent across origins, but lateral size varied significantly. Viscoelastic properties were comparable among norovirus, rotavirus, and coxsackievirus B3 vesicles but differed notably in those isolated from stool and raw wastewater. [10.1021/acs.est.6c06789]

papers.title: Population-level genomic surveillance of human norovirus using wastewater-based whole-genome sequencing.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Wastewater-based surveillance has garnered increasing attention as a valuable approach for capturing community-level infection dynamics that are often difficult to detect through clinical reporting systems alone. In this study, we analyzed human norovirus genotype distributions and whole-genome-level variations in wastewater samples collected in Gwangju, Korea. These results were interpreted in conjunction with a documented foodborne outbreak to evaluate the epidemiological relevance of wastewater-based monitoring. Human norovirus concentrations were quantified using TaqMan Array Card–based RT-qPCR, and whole-genome next-generation sequencing (NGS) was performed to obtain viral read counts and reads per kilobase per million filtered reads values. Overall, strong correlations were observed between RT-qPCR-based concentrations and NGS-derived metrics. Genotype dynamics varied among wastewater treatment plants, reflecting differences in catchment size and local population characteristics. In particular, the relative abundance of GII.17[P17] increased during epidemiological week 50, temporally coinciding with a documented local foodborne outbreak. Variant analysis revealed that wastewater samples exhibited mixed nucleotide patterns, with multiple alleles coexisting at varying relative frequencies rather than fixed substitutions. Notably, some nonsynonymous variants detected in clinical samples were also observed in wastewater samples collected surrounding the outbreak period. Together, these findings demonstrate that wastewater-based whole-genome surveillance can capture both genotype-level shifts and nucleotide-level dynamics at the population scale, highlighting its potential as a complementary tool for monitoring community-level norovirus circulation and outbreak-associated genotype dynamics. IMPORTANCE Wastewater-based surveillance is increasingly recognized as a promising approach for capturing community-level infection dynamics that are often missed by clinical surveillance. In this study, we applied whole-genome sequencing to wastewater samples collected in Gwangju, South Korea, to comprehensively characterize human norovirus genotype distributions and genetic variation. Distinct genotype patterns were observed across wastewater treatment plants, reflecting differences in catchment population size and local characteristics. Notably, an increase in the GII.17[P17] genotype detected in wastewater coincided with a foodborne outbreak investigated in Gwangju, demonstrating the potential of wastewater surveillance to reflect ongoing community transmission and emerging outbreak-associated genotypes. In addition, wastewater samples contained diverse and coexisting genetic variants, capturing population-level viral diversity and evolutionary dynamics that are not readily detected through clinical surveillance alone. source_records.title: Population-level genomic surveillance of human norovirus using wastewater-based whole-genome sequencing
source_records.abstract: ABSTRACT Wastewater-based surveillance has garnered increasing attention as a valuable approach for capturing community-level infection dynamics that are often difficult to detect through clinical reporting systems alone. In this study, we analyzed human norovirus genotype distributions and whole-genome-level variations in wastewater samples collected in Gwangju, Korea. These results were interpreted in conjunction with a documented foodborne outbreak to evaluate the epidemiological relevance of wastewater-based monitoring. Human norovirus concentrations were quantified using TaqMan Array Card–based RT-qPCR, and whole-genome next-generation sequencing (NGS) was performed to obtain viral read counts and reads per kilobase per million filtered reads values. Overall, strong correlations were observed between RT-qPCR-based concentrations and NGS-derived metrics. Genotype dynamics varied among wastewater treatment plants, reflecting differences in catchment size and local population characteristics. In particular, the relative abundance of GII.17[P17] increased during epidemiological week 50, temporally coinciding with a documented local foodborne outbreak. Variant analysis revealed that wastewater samples exhibited mixed nucleotide patterns, with multiple alleles coexisting at varying relative frequencies rather than fixed substitutions. Notably, some nonsynonymous variants detected in clinical samples were also observed in wastewater samples collected surrounding the outbreak period. Together, these findings demonstrate that wastewater-based whole-genome surveillance can capture both genotype-level shifts and nucleotide-level dynamics at the population scale, highlighting its potential as a complementary tool for monitoring community-level norovirus circulation and outbreak-associated genotype dynamics. IMPORTANCE Wastewater-based surveillance is increasingly recognized as a promising approach for capturing community-level infection dynamics that are often missed by clinical surveillance. In this study, we applied whole-genome sequencing to wastewater samples collected in Gwangju, South Korea, to comprehensively characterize human norovirus genotype distributions and genetic variation. Distinct genotype patterns were observed across wastewater treatment plants, reflecting differences in catchment population size and local characteristics. Notably, an increase in the GII.17[P17] genotype detected in wastewater coincided with a foodborne outbreak investigated in Gwangju, demonstrating the potential of wastewater surveillance to reflect ongoing community transmission and emerging outbreak-associated genotypes. In addition, wastewater samples contained diverse and coexisting genetic variants, capturing population-level viral diversity and evolutionary dynamics that are not readily detected through clinical surveillance alone. These findings highlight the value of wastewater-based whole-genome surveillance for monitoring community-level viral circulation and support its integration as a complementary strategy to existing clinical surveillance systems.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 污水基的诺如病毒监测正日益受到关注,作为一种捕捉社区层面感染动态的有效方法,这些动态往往难以通过临床报告系统单独检测。在本研究中,我们分析了韩国光州市收集的污水样本中人类诺如病毒基因型分布和全基因组层面的变异情况。这些结果结合了已记录的当地诺如病毒暴发事件进行解读,以评估污水基监测在流行病学上的相关性。人类诺如病毒浓度通过基于TaqMan Array Card的RT-qPCR进行量化,同时进行全基因组下一代测序(NGS)以获得病毒读数计数和每百万过滤读数每千碱基的读数比例。总体而言,RT-qPCR测得的浓度与NGS衍生的指标之间观察到了强相关性。基因型动态在不同污水处理厂中有所差异,反映了不同集水区规模和当地人口特征的差异。特别是,在流行病学第50周期间,GII.17[P17]基因型的相对丰度增加,时间上与记录的当地诺如病毒暴发事件相吻合。变异分析显示,污水样本表现出混合的核苷酸模式,多个等位基因以不同的相对频率共存,而非固定的替代。值得注意的是,一些在临床样本中检测到的非同义变异也在诺如病毒暴发期间收集的污水样本中被观察到。这些发现表明,污水基的全基因组测序能够捕捉到群体层面的基因型变化和核苷酸层面的动态,凸显了其作为监测社区层面诺如病毒传播和与暴发相关的基因型动态的补充工具的潜力。重要性 污水基的诺如病毒监测正日益被认可为一种捕捉临床监测常忽略的社区层面感染动态的有前景方法。在本研究中,我们对韩国光州市收集的污水样本进行了全基因组测序,以全面表征人类诺如病毒的基因型分布和遗传变异。在不同污水处理厂中观察到了不同的基因型模式,反映了集水区人口规模和当地特征的差异。值得注意的是,在污水中检测到的GII.17[P17]基因型相对丰度增加的时间与光州市记录的诺如病毒暴发事件相吻合,这表明污水基的诺如病毒监测能够反映正在进行的社区感染情况和新兴的与暴发相关的基因型。此外,污水样本中包含了多样且共存的遗传变异,捕捉了群体层面的病毒多样性及进化动态,这些是单独通过临床监测难以检测到的。这些发现突显了污水基全基因组监测在监测社区层面病毒传播中的价值,并支持其作为现有临床监测系统的补充策略进行整合。

papers.title: Clinical and Public Health Lessons from a Point-Source Polymicrobial Foodborne Outbreak: Implications for Vaccination of Vulnerable Populations
papers.abstract: Background: Foodborne outbreaks remain a major public health concern, particularly for immunocompromised individuals who experience a disproportionate burden of severe enteric disease. Although environmental prevention represents the cornerstone of food safety, outbreak investigations may also provide valuable evidence for identifying populations that could benefit most from future vaccination strategies. This study investigated a point-source foodborne outbreak in Southern Italy to describe clinical outcomes among exposed individuals, including an immunocompromised oncology patient, and to explore the potential relevance of host vulnerability for future enteric vaccine research. Methods: A retrospective cohort study combined with an environmental outbreak investigation was conducted following a restaurant-associated gastroenteritis cluster. Clinical data, epidemiological information, and laboratory findings were collected for all exposed individuals. Stool samples were analyzed using multiplex real-time polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR), while microbiological and molecular analyses were performed on kitchen water samples collected during the official sanitary inspection. Results: Four of six exposed individuals developed acute gastroenteritis (overall attack rate: 66.7%; food-specific attack rate: 100%) within 24–48 h after consuming the same meal. Three previously healthy adults experienced prolonged symptoms lasting 15–21 days and subsequently developed post-infectious irritable bowel syndrome (PI-IBS) during follow-up. In contrast, a 43-year-old woman receiving cisplatin chemotherapy for cervical cancer developed severe dehydration requiring emergency hospitalization. Multiplex RT-PCR identified polymicrobial infection with Campylobacter spp., norovirus, and three diarrheagenic Escherichia coli pathotypes (EAEC, EPEC, and ETEC). Environmental investigation demonstrated contamination of the restaurant’s kitchen water supply with total coliforms (>80 CFU/100 mL), intestinal Enterococci (30 CFU/100 mL) and norovirus genogroups I and II, confirming the common source of exposure. Conclusions: This outbreak demonstrates how identical environmental exposure may result in markedly different clinical outcomes according to host immune status. While rigorous food safety measures remain essential, these findings may help develop hypotheses regarding populations that could be considered in future studies of enteric vaccination strategies. Outbreak investigations may therefore contribute not only to source identification and outbreak control but also to informing future vaccination strategies for vulnerable populations.

papers.title_zh: 临床和公共卫生教训:意大利南部一起点源多病原体食源性 暴发:对易感人群疫苗接种的启示
papers.source_body_en: Background: Foodborne outbreaks remain a major public health concern, particularly for immunocompromised individuals who experience a disproportionate burden of severe enteric disease. Although environmental prevention represents the cornerstone of food safety, outbreak investigations may also provide valuable evidence for identifying populations that could benefit most from future vaccination strategies. This study investigated a point-source foodborne outbreak in Southern Italy to describe clinical outcomes among exposed individuals, including an immunocompromised oncology patient, and to explore the potential relevance of host vulnerability for future enteric vaccine research. Methods: A retrospective cohort study combined with an environmental outbreak investigation was conducted following a restaurant-associated gastroenteritis cluster. Clinical data, epidemiological information, and laboratory findings were collected for all exposed individuals. Stool samples were analyzed using multiplex real-time polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR), while microbiological and molecular analyses were performed on kitchen water samples collected during the official sanitary inspection. Results: Four of six exposed individuals developed acute gastroenteritis (overall attack rate: 66.7%; food-specific attack rate: 100%) within 24–48 h after consuming the same meal. Three previously healthy adults experienced prolonged symptoms lasting 15–21 days and subsequently developed post-infectious irritable bowel syndrome (PI-IBS) during follow-up. In contrast, a 43-year-old woman receiving cisplatin chemotherapy for cervical cancer developed severe dehydration requiring emergency hospitalization. Multiplex RT-PCR identified polymicrobial infection with Campylobacter spp., norovirus, and three diarrheagenic Escherichia coli pathotypes (EAEC, EPEC, and ETEC). Environmental investigation demonstrated contamination of the restaurant’s kitchen water supply with total coliforms (>80 CFU/100 mL), intestinal Enterococci (30 CFU/100 mL) and norovirus genogroups I and II, confirming the common source of exposure. Conclusions: This outbreak demonstrates how identical environmental exposure may result in markedly different clinical outcomes according to host immune status. While rigorous food safety measures remain essential, these findings may help develop hypotheses regarding populations that could be considered in future studies of enteric vaccination strategies. Outbreak investigations may therefore contribute not only to source identification and outbreak control but also to informing future vaccination strategies for vulnerable populations.

papers.title: Occurrence of Enteric Viruses in Multi-Component Salad Bowls
papers.abstract: The expansion of e-commerce and last-mile food delivery has created an increasingly relevant but understudied context for food safety surveillance. However, the occurrence of enteric viruses in ready-to-eat (RTE) foods within this distribution context remains largely unexplored. This study aimed to investigate the presence of enteric viruses in multi-component RTE salad bowls obtained through last-mile delivery. The study was designed to characterize the virological status of products received through this distribution pathway, without attributing any detected contamination specifically to the delivery process itself. A total of 30 salad samples were collected in two independent batches over a two-month interval via a third-party e-commerce platform and delivered directly to the laboratory. Virus concentration was performed using a method based on ISO 15216-1:2017, followed by RNA extraction and reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) detection of norovirus (NoV) genogroups I (GI) and II (GII), hepatitis A virus (HAV), hepatitis E virus (HEV), human astrovirus (HAstV), and rotavirus (RV). HEV-target RT-qPCR signals were observed in 5 of 30 samples (16.7%); however, all positive signals corresponded to levels below the estimated limit of quantification (LOQ). No RT-qPCR amplification was observed for the other targeted viruses. This study provides initial occurrence data for enteric viruses in multi-component RTE meals obtained through last-mile delivery and supports the inclusion of this food category and emerging distribution pathways in foodborne virus surveillance.

papers.abstract_zh: 电子商务和最后一公里食品配送的扩展为食品安全创造了日益相关但研究不足的背景监测。然而,在这种配送背景下即食(RTE)食品中肠道病毒的出现仍 largely unexplored。本研究旨在调查通过最后一公里配送获得的多组分即食沙拉碗中肠道病毒的存在情况。本研究设计旨在表征通过该配送途径获得的产品的病毒学状态,而不将检测到的污染具体归因于配送过程本身。通过第三方电商平台,在两个月的时间间隔内独立采集了30份沙拉样本,并直接送至实验室。病毒浓缩采用基于ISO 15216-1:2017的方法,随后进行RNA提取和逆转录定量聚合酶链反应(RT-qPCR)检测诺如病毒(诺如病毒)基因组I(GI)和II(GII)、甲型肝炎病毒(HAV)、乙型肝炎病毒(HEV)、人类星状病毒(HAstV)和轮状病毒(RV)。在5份样本(16.7%)中观察到HEV靶向RT-qPCR信号;然而,所有阳性信号均对应于低于估计定量限(LOQ)的水平。对于其他靶向病毒,未观察到RT-qPCR扩增。本研究提供了通过最后一公里配送获得的多组分即食餐中肠道病毒的初步出现数据,并支持将该食品类别和新兴配送途径纳入食源性病毒监测的监测范围。

papers.title: Evolution, diversity and distribution of human Noroviruses:From single hosts to global patterns
papers.abstract: Norovirus, a member of the Caliciviridae family, is a major cause of acute gastroenteritis (AGE) worldwide, affecting all age groups and causing substantial morbidity and mortality. Children in developing countries, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals are particularly affected. Currently, no specific antivirals or vaccines are licensed for norovirus treatment or prevention. Therapeutic development is complicated by the virus's high diversity, with more than 10 genogroups (GI–GX) and approximately 50 genotypes, some of which, such as GII.4, continuously generate new antigenic variants. However, the emergence of norovirus diversity, the relationship between within-host and community-level evolution, and the association between viral diversity and treatment outcome remain incompletely understood. Therefore, this thesis aims to improve our understanding of norovirus evolution and epidemiology by addressing two main topics: norovirus diversity and evolution in different hosts, and the use of wastewater-based sequencing to monitor viral diversity and circulation at the population level.

Currently, no specific antivirals or vaccines are licensed for norovirus treatment or prevention. Therapeutic development is complicated by the virus's high diversity, with more than 10 genogroups (GI–GX) and approximately 50 genotypes, some of which, such as GII.4, continuously generate new antigenic variants. However, the emergence of norovirus diversity, the relationship between within-host and community-level evolution, and the association between viral diversity and treatment outcome remain incompletely understood. Therefore, this thesis aims to improve our understanding of norovirus evolution and epidemiology by addressing two main topics: norovirus diversity and evolution in different hosts, and the use of wastewater-based sequencing to monitor viral diversity and circulation at the population level.

papers.abstract_zh: 诺如病毒 是杯状病毒科的一员,是世界范围内 急性胃肠炎 (AGE) 的主要原因,影响所有年龄段并导致大量发病率和 死亡率。发展中国家的儿童、老年人和免疫功能低下的人尤其受到影响。目前,没有特定的 抗病毒药物 或 疫苗 被许可用于 诺如病毒 治疗 或预防。该病毒具有超过 10 个基因组 (GI–GX) 和大约 50 个基因型,其中一些基因型(例如 GII.4)不断产生新的抗原变体,因此治疗开发变得复杂。然而,诺如病毒 多样性的出现、宿主 内部和社区层面 进化 之间的关系以及病毒多样性与 治疗 结果之间的关联仍不完全清楚。因此,本论文旨在通过解决两个主要主题:不同宿主中的诺如病毒多样性和进化,以及使用基于废水的测序来监测人群水平上的病毒多样性和传播,来提高我们对诺如病毒 进化和流行病学的理解。

papers.abstract: Abstract Vesicle-cloaked virus clusters, or viral vesicles, represent an emerging pathogenic form of enteric viruses, exhibiting enhanced infectivity, environmental persistence, and resistance to disinfection compared to free viruses. Their unique vesicle architecture and mechanical properties likely play a critical role in maintaining structural integrity and shielding encapsulated virions from environmental stressors. Here, we employed atomic force microscopy to characterize the topography and viscoelasticity of viral vesicles from cell cultures, clinical stool, and municipal wastewater. When immobilized on a substrate, the vesicle height remained relatively consistent across origins, whereas the lateral size varied substantially. Viscoelastic properties, characterized by short-term stiffness, long-term stiffness, and dissipation coefficient, were comparable among norovirus, rotavirus, and coxsackievirus B3 vesicles derived from diverse host cells but differed significantly in vesicles isolated from stool and raw wastewater. These differences likely arise from interactions between environmental constituents and conditions in these matrices and the vesicle membranes. A clear decline in vesicle viscoelasticity was also observed during the wastewater treatment process. In summary, these results indicate that viral vesicle viscoelasticity is not a fixed intrinsic property but is strongly influenced by environmental conditions, with complex matrices reshaping the mechanical behavior, persistence, and associated environmental risks.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the viscoelastic properties of viral vesicles, particularly those of norovirus, to understand their environmental persistence. Using atomic force microscopy, researchers found that vesicle height remained consistent across different origins, but lateral size varied. Viscoelastic properties were similar among norovirus, rotavirus, and coxsackievirus B3 but differed in stool and wastewater samples. The authors suggest that environmental conditions significantly influence these properties, which could reshape the mechanical behavior and persistence of viral vesicles. The findings highlight the importance of environmental factors in viral survival and risk, offering potential insights for surveillance and risk assessment. However, the study's reliance on abstract-only evidence and potential unmeasured variables limit its confidence, resulting in a moderate assessment.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究采用原子力显微镜分析来自细胞培养物、临床粪便样本和市政污水中的病毒囊泡,重点关注诺如病毒、轮状病毒和柯萨奇病毒B3。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用原子力显微镜对病毒囊泡的形貌和粘弹性进行了表征,测量了不同环境基质中短期刚度、长期刚度和耗散系数等参数。
elements_zh.main_results: 囊泡高度在不同来源中保持一致,但横向尺寸存在显著差异。诺如病毒、轮状病毒和柯萨奇病毒B3的囊泡粘弹性特性在不同来源中表现出相似性,但在从粪便和原始污水中分离出的囊泡中则存在明显差异。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,病毒囊泡的粘弹性特性并非固定不变,而是受到环境条件的影响,这提示复杂的基质可能改变其机械行为以及相关的环境风险。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果提供了关于环境因素如何影响病毒囊泡的持久性和相关风险的见解,这可能有助于改进监测以及针对诺如病毒及相关病原体的风险评估策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的结果基于摘要证据,粘弹性差异可能受到未测量的环境变量的影响,因此证据强度评估为中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 包被囊泡的病毒簇,或称为病毒囊泡,代表了一种新兴的肠道病毒致病形式,相较于游离病毒,表现出增强的感染性、环境持久性和对消毒剂的抵抗力。其独特的囊泡结构和机械特性可能在维持结构完整性并保护封装的病毒颗粒免受环境应激因素影响方面起着关键作用。在此研究中,我们采用原子力显微镜对来自细胞培养物、临床粪便样本和市政污水中的病毒囊泡的形貌和粘弹性进行了表征。当病毒囊泡被固定在基底上时,其高度在不同来源中保持相对一致,而横向尺寸则存在显著差异。粘弹性特性,包括短期刚度、长期刚度和耗散系数,在来自不同宿主细胞的诺如病毒、轮状病毒和柯萨奇病毒B3的囊泡中表现出相似性,但在从粪便和原始污水中分离出的囊泡中则存在显著差异。这些差异可能源于这些基质中的环境成分与囊泡膜之间的相互作用。此外,在污水治疗处理过程中也观察到了囊泡粘弹性的明显下降。总之,这些结果表明,病毒囊泡的粘弹性并非固有的固定属性,而是强烈受到环境条件的影响,复杂的基质可能重塑其机械行为、持久性以及相关的环境风险。

papers.title: Multicentre Evaluation of Cepheid Xpert® Research-Use-Only Panel for Molecular Rapid Detection of Gastrointestinal Pathogens
papers.abstract: Rapid and accurate identification of enteric pathogens is essential for the management of acute infectious diarrhoeal diseases. Multiplex PCR panels have emerged as first-line screening tools to conventional stool culture by providing broad pathogen coverage and shorter turnaround times. This study evaluated the diagnostic performance of the Cepheid Xpert gastrointestinal (GI) research-use-only (RUO) panel in routine clinical practice across multiple European centres. A multicentre study was conducted in four hospitals across France, Germany and Italy. Stool specimens collected as part of routine care were tested using local standard-of-care (SoC) methods, including conventional stool culture, BDMax® Enteric Panels, or BioFire FilmArray® GI Panel, and subsequently analysed using the Cepheid Xpert GI RUO panel. A total of 11 bacterial, viral and parasitic enteropathogens were targeted. Discordant results underwent additional testing, and a consensus result based on a two-out-of-three agreement rule was used as the reference standard. Diagnostic performance metrics, agreement with SoC methods, microbiological findings and turnaround times were assessed. Of 508 samples, 115 (22.6%) were identified as positive for at least one pathogen according to the consensus result, including 12 samples with co-detection of more than one pathogen (10.4% of positive samples), resulting in a total of 128 pathogens detected. The most frequently detected pathogens were Campylobacter spp. (37 specimens), Norovirus (26 specimens), and Salmonella spp. Compared with the consensus reference standard, Xpert achieved an overall sensitivity of 98% (95% CI: 94–100%), specificity of 100% (95% CI: 100–100%), positive predictive value of 95% (95% CI: 90–98%), and negative predictive value of 100% (95% CI: 100–100%). Sensitivity was ≥95% and specificity ≥99% for all evaluable targets. Agreement with routine diagnostic methods was high, with overall positive and negative percent agreements exceeding 90% and a Cohen’s kappa coefficient of 0.91. Median analytical turnaround time was 1 h 18 min for Xpert, compared with 3 h for BDMax, 1 h 15 min for BioFire and 48 h for conventional stool culture. The Cepheid Xpert GI (RUO) panel provided highly accurate detection of enteric pathogens across heterogeneous European diagnostic settings and reduced turnaround time by more than 95% compared with conventional stool culture. A future IVD version of this test could provide rapid and accurate detection of enteric pathogens for potential routine management of patients with suspected acute infectious gastroenteritis.

However, the study's limited geographic scope may affect generalisability, and the evidence strength is considered high due to the use of a consensus reference standard and comprehensive performance metrics.

papers.title_zh: 多中心评估Cepheid Xpert®研究用面板用于胃肠道病原体的分子快速检测
papers.source_body_en: Rapid and accurate identification of enteric pathogens is essential for the management of acute infectious diarrhoeal diseases. Multiplex PCR panels have emerged as first-line screening tools to conventional stool culture by providing broad pathogen coverage and shorter turnaround times. This study evaluated the diagnostic performance of the Cepheid Xpert gastrointestinal (GI) research-use-only (RUO) panel in routine clinical practice across multiple European centres. A multicentre study was conducted in four hospitals across France, Germany and Italy. Stool specimens collected as part of routine care were tested using local standard-of-care (SoC) methods, including conventional stool culture, BDMax® Enteric Panels, or BioFire FilmArray® GI Panel, and subsequently analysed using the Cepheid Xpert GI RUO panel. A total of 11 bacterial, viral and parasitic enteropathogens were targeted. Discordant results underwent additional testing, and a consensus result based on a two-out-of-three agreement rule was used as the reference standard. Diagnostic performance metrics, agreement with SoC methods, microbiological findings and turnaround times were assessed. Of 508 samples, 115 (22.6%) were identified as positive for at least one pathogen according to the consensus result, including 12 samples with co-detection of more than one pathogen (10.4% of positive samples), resulting in a total of 128 pathogens detected. The most frequently detected pathogens were Campylobacter spp. (37 specimens), Norovirus (26 specimens), and Salmonella spp. Compared with the consensus reference standard, Xpert achieved an overall sensitivity of 98% (95% CI: 94–100%), specificity of 100% (95% CI: 100–100%), positive predictive value of 95% (95% CI: 90–98%), and negative predictive value of 100% (95% CI: 100–100%). Sensitivity was ≥95% and specificity ≥99% for all evaluable targets. Agreement with routine diagnostic methods was high, with overall positive and negative percent agreements exceeding 90% and a Cohen’s kappa coefficient of 0.91. Median analytical turnaround time was 1 h 18 min for Xpert, compared with 3 h for BDMax, 1 h 15 min for BioFire and 48 h for conventional stool culture. The Cepheid Xpert GI (RUO) panel provided highly accurate detection of enteric pathogens across heterogeneous European diagnostic settings and reduced turnaround time by more than 95% compared with conventional stool culture. A future IVD version of this test could provide rapid and accurate detection of enteric pathogens for potential routine management of patients with suspected acute infectious gastroenteritis.
papers.abstract_zh: 快速而准确地识别肠道病原体对于急性感染性腹泻疾病的管理至关重要。多重PCR面板已成为常规粪便培养的首选筛查工具,因为它提供了广泛的病原体覆盖范围和更短的周转时间。本研究评估了Cepheid Xpert胃肠(GI)研究用途(RUO)面板在多个欧洲中心的常规临床实践中诊断性能。在法国、德国和意大利的四家医院进行了多中心研究。作为常规护理的一部分收集的粪便标本使用当地的标准护理(SoC)方法进行检测,包括常规粪便培养、BDMax®肠道面板或BioFire FilmArray®GI面板,随后使用Cepheid Xpert GI RUO面板进行分析。总共针对11种细菌、病毒和寄生虫肠道病原体进行了检测。对于不一致的结果进行了额外的测试,并使用两个中的两个一致规则作为参考标准。评估了诊断性能指标、与SoC方法的一致性、微生物学发现和周转时间。在508个样本中,根据共识结果有115个(22.6%)样本至少检测到一种病原体,其中包括12个样本同时检测到多种病原体(阳性样本的10.4%),总共检测到128种病原体。最常见的病原体是弯曲杆菌属(37例)、诺如病毒(26例)和沙门氏菌属。与共识参考标准相比,Xpert的整体灵敏度为98%(95% CI:94-100%),特异性为100%(95% CI:100-100%),阳性预测值为95%(95% CI:90-98%),阴性预测值为100%(95% CI:100-100%)。所有可评估目标的灵敏度≥95%,特异性≥99%。与常规诊断方法的一致性很高,总体阳性百分比一致性超过90%,Cohen’s kappa系数为0.91。Xpert的中位分析周转时间为1小时18分钟,而BDMax为3小时,BioFire为1小时15分钟,常规粪便培养为48小时。Cepheid Xpert GI(RUO)面板在异质性欧洲诊断环境中提供了高度准确的肠道病原体检测,并将常规粪便培养的周转时间减少了超过95%。该测试的未来体外诊断(IVD)版本可以为疑似急性感染性胃肠炎患者的潜在常规管理提供快速而准确的肠道病原体检测。

Learn more Get Finance Plus Cocrystal Pharma’s new CEO hopes to crack the norovirus code PharmaVoice, an Industry Dive publication · Pharma Voice · Industry Dive Alexandra Pecci Tue, September 15, 2026 at 1:56 AM PDT 6 min read COCP This story was originally published on PharmaVoice. To receive daily news and insights, subscribe to our free daily PharmaVoice newsletter. Welcome to First 90 Days, a series dedicated to examining how pharma executives are planning for success in their new roles. Today, we're in conversation with James Sapirstein, the new CEO of Cocrystal Pharma, which is advancing an antiviral candidate for norovirus. Norovirus is the bane of cruise ships, long-term care facilities and schools, ripping through close quarters with remarkable speed and striking those it sickens with sudden and severe stomach problems. "What we hear from patients is that norovirus won't kill you, but you wish it did," said James Sapirstein, the new CEO of Cocrystal Pharma. Norovirus can be fatal: The CDC estimates it causes about 900 deaths annually in the U.S., mostly among older adults. But clinical-stage Cocrystal is hoping to change that with its lead candidate, CDI-988, an oral antiviral that received FDA fast track designation for norovirus treatment and prophylaxis. The drug is currently in a placebo-controlled phase 1b human challenge study at Emory University School of Medicine that completed dosing its last participant. The company expects preliminary results in late 2026 or early 2027. The cost of the stomach bug is high. Every year, norovirus causes an estimated 685 million illnesses, triggering $60 billion worldwide in healthcare costs and lost productivity. In the U.S., the virus causes about 109,000 hospitalizations every year, according to the CDC. Despite that burden, there's no specific medicine to treat norovirus; care focuses on replacing lost fluids and managing symptoms, including with medicines like Imodium. And drug R&D for norovirus is tricky business. "The virus is just too smart. And that's the difficulty," Sapirstein said. That difficulty was evident in July when Moderna reported that its norovirus vaccine candidate, mRNA-1403, fell short of the statistical criteria for early success at the phase 3 interim analysis. The company said it will enroll an additional cohort. Two years earlier, the Takeda Pharmaceuticals spinout, HilleVax, struck out in a mid-stage study when its norovirus vaccine failed to meet its primary efficacy endpoint in infants. Cocrystal is taking a different approach, and not only because its candidate is an antiviral, rather than a vaccine. "In the past, I think other companies have gone after the full boat of norovirus [strains] and have not been successful. We're going after a very specific strain [in our challenge study]. And if that works, we'll go after the other strains," Sapirstein said, adding that the company's platform, which draws on the expertise of Nobel laureate and company chairman Roger Kornberg, allows for such customization. Story Continues In taking up the CEO mantle, Sapirstein aims to bring operational and commercial expertise to what has been a science-focused company, which is developing a suite of novel antiviral candidates. "This is a microcap company at this point. We're trying to build it out, and I'm trying to turn the story around," he said. Sapirstein is also interested in dealmaking, whether that means acquiring companies or assets, or being acquired. Sapirstein joined Cocrystal in June after many years in the antiviral space, including leading the global launch of the HIV drug, tenofovir, marketed as Viread, at Gilead Sciences. He also held senior positions at Bristol Myers Squibb and Serono Laboratories, and prior CEO roles at Tobira Therapeutics and Contravir Pharmaceuticals. Here, he discusses how CEOs shape and tell company stories, how his prior experiences inform his current role and how Cocrystal could position its norovirus drug on the market. This interview has been edited for brevity and style. PHARMAVOICE: Do you view your role as CEO as shaping a story and a narrative for a company? JAMES SAPIRSTEIN: I do, because that's exactly what my career has been about. For instance, when I was recruited from Bristol Myers [to Gilead], people thought, my goodness, you're crazy. Why are you moving cross country to Gilead, which had just failed at the FDA with [the HIV candidate] adefovir? But I talked to scientific advisors who told me [that another HIV candidate] tenofovir's got legs. They need someone like you that can help shape the strategy. So I became known as a turnaround agent. Gilead was not doing very well. We weren't profitable. I also was part of the team that helped convince our CEO and board to acquire Triangle Pharmaceuticals which eventually [resulted in the first HIV PrEP medicine] Truvada. Cancer still dominates pharma R&D. Obesity is gaining ground. Merck builds around Keytruda; prediction markets raise new risks mRNA cancer vaccines’ biggest barriers to market The Latest Permission granted by Takeda Andy Plump, architect of Takeda’s R&D overhaul, to retire next year Plump joined Takeda during a turbulent period, pushed the company to work more closely with young biotechs and will leave it with what CEO Julie Kim called a “lasting foundation.” Leadership Permission granted by Evonik Sponsored by Evonik Making oral drug delivery more sustainable with measurable product-level data How auditable LCA data can guide more informed sustainability decisions. Pharma Getty Images 5 questions that could determine Alzheimer’s next chapter “The Alzheimer’s space has really got a fire under it,” says one analyst. But can the momentum deliver better drugs? Biotech Getty Images Merck pairs ADCs with Keytruda in women’s cancer push The drugmaker hopes to move the needle on challenging cancers and shore up its pipeline as it prepares for the Keytruda patent cliff. Pharma Sarah Silbiger via Getty Images FDA gains ‘continuity’ as Mikhail, Davis named permanent CBER, CDER leaders After almost two years of turnover in the FDA’s top ranks, the new appointments should help ease concerns about more turmoil ahead, one analyst said. Biotech Scott Olson/Staff via Getty Images Prediction markets are putting a price on pharma’s secrets. Here’s what companies need to know. As betting expands into clinical trial outcomes, drugmakers may need to look beyond employees and scrutinize outside partners with access to sensitive information. Pharma Joe Raedle via Getty Images As measles outbreaks soar, where does drug R&D stand? More than 25 years after it was declared eliminated, measles has surged back. But drug R&D is still in early stages and up against a tense market environment. Biotech Justin Sullivan via Getty Images Gilead’s growing HIV franchise; cell therapy licensing deals plummet The FDA recently OK'd Gilead's novel HIV combo med, and cell therapy deals have fallen dramatically in two years. Biotech Andrew Harnik via Getty Images China’s clinical trial boom under scrutiny after 3 deaths come to light Two House Republicans are asking the FDA to increase oversight of China-generated clinical data after three trial deaths are reported. Pharma Getty Images Autoimmune CAR-T faces tough questions after Novartis, Bristol Myers study halts Wall Street analysts believe that a more cautious approach to manufacturing, study enrollment and side effect management could help developers avoid future safety hazards. Patient Permission granted by Gilead Sciences Gilead takes a ‘different’ approach to reaching the Black community with new HIV campaign Gilead’s new “Up to Date” campaign uses humor and dating scenarios to reach Black communities amid persistent gaps in HIV prevention and PrEP use. Commercialization Getty Images The hidden scale-out problem behind CAR-T’s growth CAR-T’s commercial challenge isn’t making bigger batches. It’s making thousands of patient-specific manufacturing runs behave like one reliable system. In vivo aims to eliminate the batch altogether. Commercialization Getty Images Social anxiety drugs have been floundering in the clinic. Could Eli Lilly help tip the scales? After two notable failures, the social anxiety R&D space gained a major player when Eli Lilly agreed to acquire AtaiBeckley this year. Research & Development Permission granted by Argenx Q&A // First 90 Days A single drug made Argenx one of the most valuable biotechs in Europe. Its new CEO is ready for the next act. Under its new chief, Karen Massey, Argenx is positioning its blockbuster Vyvgart to become the Keytruda of the autoimmune disease space. Leadership Alamy New data could widen use of AstraZeneca, Amgen immune disease drug Tezspire succeeded in a study in eosinophilic esophagitis, which could become the drug’s third approved indication and unlock what’s viewed as a blockbuster opportunity. Research & Development Permission granted by GSK Pharma’s new CEOs to watch New leaders at GSK, Novo Nordisk and Sanofi are taking the reins at pivotal moments for three of pharma’s largest companies. Leadership Getty Images 3 takeover targets in immunology Dealmaking in the autoimmune space is thriving as biotechs chase new targets with the potential to treat more conditions. Biotech Getty Images Q&A Is AI finally proving its worth in drug R&D? A Tufts analysis found that an AI clinical monitoring agent could deliver up to $21 million in value for a late-stage program in oncology R&D. But will the findings apply in more therapeutic areas? Research & Development Getty Images Q&A Legend’s interim CEO sees a shorter path to the next era of CAR-T Alan Bash explains how Carvykti informed the company’s strategy and what its in vivo platform still needs to prove. Leadership Permission granted by Tyra Biosciences Tyra’s one-drug, three-indication bet nears its first phase 2 test What started as two neighbors trading shop talk has grown into Tyra Biosciences, a clinical-stage biotech company with a blockbuster potential pipeline. Biotech Getty Images Moderna and Merck’s cancer vaccine clears phase 3; Ultragenyx lands gene therapy nod A personalized mRNA therapy met two melanoma trial goals, the FDA cleared the first treatment for GSDIa, and Novo tests lower doses of its obesity pill. Biotech Claudio Ventrella via Getty Images 3 potential blockbusters beyond obesity to watch Late-stage drugs in pancreatic cancer, multiple myeloma and Alzheimer’s could pair treatment advances with major commercial upside. Pharma Getty Images Opinion The scientific research pharma leaders keep sharing — and why Six industry leaders share the scientific papers they keep circulating, spanning transplants, MASH, cancer, real-world evidence and trial design. Biotech Getty Images How cost and perception could reshape the GLP-1 market As Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk race for share, surveys show affordability and prescribing preferences may help decide the winners. Commercialization Sarah Silbiger via Getty Images Trump nominates policy aide Overton to lead FDA Heidi Overton, a medical doctor and veteran of the America First think tank, currently serves as deputy director of the White House Domestic Policy Council. Stock photo of the mega cruise ship "Caribbean Princess" 12 May, 2026 by Alba Fortea 👁️ 745 Over a hundred norovirus cases hit the cruise ship "Caribbean Princess" during Caribbean voyage More than 100 people have fallen ill aboard the cruise ship "Caribbean Princess" due to an outbreak of norovirus, a highly contagious virus that causes acute gastroenteritis. This has been reported by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. In total, of the 3,116 passengers traveling on the ship, 102 reported gastrointestinal symptoms, along with 13 crew members, bringing the total number of affected individuals to 115. The most common symptoms reported include vomiting and diarrhea. The cruise ship "Caribbean Princess" (IMO 9215490) set sail under the Bermuda flag from Fort Lauderdale (Florida) on April 28 and completed its itinerary on May 11 in Port Canaveral. The cruise line Princess Cruises has stated that this is “a limited number of cases with mild gastrointestinal symptoms.” The ship "Caribbean Princess" will undergo thorough cleaning and disinfection before starting its next itinerary. news.content_zh: 美国疾病控制与预防中心报告称,"加勒比公主号"邮轮在加勒比航行期间发生了一起急性胃肠炎暴发事件。该邮轮于2026年4月28日从佛罗里达劳德代尔堡出发,并于2026年5月11日完成行程。在3,116名乘客中,有102人报告出现胃肠道症状,加上13名船员,共计115名受影响个体。最常见的症状是呕吐和腹泻。公主邮轮表示,这些病例数量有限且症状轻微,并确认该邮轮将在下次航行前进行彻底的清洁和消毒。该报告于2026年9月10日发布,并提供了完整原始文章内容。

The four-star hotel close to Athlone closed on 26 August, following advice from the HSE. In a statement, the HSE said it had been "investigating an outbreak of gastrointestinal illness affecting people who attended premises in Westmeath". A number of weddings planned for the hotel had to be cancelled during the closure. The hotel confirmed to RTÉ News that it has now re-opened. news.content: Airline Sale Railway Bus Hotel Travel agency Column Travel Information Car Discover more Consult Online Doctors hotel Reserve A Table / Hotel Norovirus Food Poisoning Reported at Rizzan Sea-Park Hotel Tancha Bay Restaurant Friday, September 11, 2026 Editorial Department Rizzan Sea-Park Hotel Tancha Bay in Okinawa announced that a norovirus food poisoning incident occurred at its Seaside Restaurant Tancha Bay. Discover GERD Treatments Discover more Compare Hotel Deals health Food According to the Ryukyu Shimpo, the onset dates ranged from August 30 to September 3, with 25 of the 36 people who dined at the restaurant becoming ill. The Chubu Public Health Center ordered the restaurant to suspend operations for four days from September 8. Breakfast and dinner for staying guests will be served at three venues: Blue Lagoon restaurant, Ibis barbecue restaurant, and Shichifuku Japanese restaurant. As measures to prevent recurrence, the hotel will provide thorough hygiene management training to all employees, not only kitchen staff, under the guidance of the public health center. It will reinforce handwashing and hand sanitization, hold training sessions instructed by the public health center, and sanitize tables after meals are served. In addition, regular health checks for all staff involved in restaurant operations and study sessions on food poisoning will be conducted. The kitchens will be disinfected by specialist contractors, and inspections of cleaning equipment used in dining areas will be carried out more frequently.
